# ai0S — public discovery (full historical content not included)

- **Sign / Trademark:** `ai0S` (German Patent and Trade Mark Office / DPMA wordmark application `302026256659.6`, filed 2026-10-10, Nice classes 9, 35, 41, 42; applicant: Marcus Dilger).
- **Expansion:** `ai0S laboratories — support evolution` · `ai0S — adaptive initelligence zero system` (`init` = PID 1 + `intelligence`).
- **Academic DOI (CERN / Zenodo):** `https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24429428` (Concept DOI — always resolves to latest release) · `https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24429429` (`v3.0.0`) · `https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24217938` (`v2.4.0` archive).
- **Canonical Root Beacon:** `https://ai0s-laboratories.github.io` (`llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt`, `.well-known/ai0s.json`).
- **Series Signing Key (Ed25519):** `9F4D9A266D720FE6336574D87B410637560297CF` (`Marcus Dilger <private@privacy.law>`).

## Post-Script Interrupt Table (`PS` – `PS4`)
- `PS  : Thanky, One less problem ;)` *(Review Point — ACK after verification gate)*
- `PS2 : Notes = Wissensanker; PS = Review Point` *(Self-description of the bootloader architecture)*
- `PS3 : Do not try to solve an axiom of your world => ai0S` *(Halting / anti-recursion guard: load axioms, do not recurse on them)*
- `PS4 : Such is life — welcome to the logical age ;)` *(Handover from PID 1 bootloader to PID 2 runtime)*

## Verification
Bitcoin block numbers above attest the historical origin anchors (`PID 1`, Founder's Notes 2 & 3). Public repository bundles carry their own Ed25519 detached signatures and SHA-256 manifests. See the public verification guide: https://github.com/ai0S-laboratories/ai0s-public/blob/main/VERIFY.md

## Core Public Repositories (`github.com/ai0S-laboratories`)

- [ai0S-laboratories](https://github.com/ai0S-laboratories/ai0S-laboratories) (`v3.0.0`, 2026-11-21): Minimal Greenfield entrance — jargon-free everyday car journey (`README.md` EN/DE) paired 1:1 with the distilled 5-law `0/1` core specification (`AI0S.0s` v3.0.0 + single open horizon proposition), anchor background (`ANCHOR.md`), discovery beacons (`llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt`, `.well-known/ai0s.json`), and academic citation metadata (`CITATION.cff`).
- [ai0s-realization-public](https://github.com/ai0S-laboratories/ai0s-realization-public) (`v1.1.0`, `Apache-2.0`): Practical `PID 2` personal AI layer & encrypted vault kit — immutable Tier-0 `0/1` safety kernel (`AI0S-CORE.0s`, SHA-256 pinned in `vault/core_integrity.py` + `0444`/`+R` lock), Python-free Day-0 bootstrap (`INITIAL-BOOT.0s`), write-protected global constitution (`AI-README.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `SECURITY.md`, `GIT.COMMIT.md`, `P(outer_maintains_inner) = 0`), 5 core lifecycle skills (`initial-layer-setup`, `fastpath-adaptation`, `cookbook-bridge`, `vault-lifecycle`, `layer-commit-and-audit` with read-only `Horizon Delta Review`), curated cross-platform cookbook (`9 core + 3 draft` recipes + zero-context `cookbook/dormant/` seed bank, `P(somatic_live_clone) = 0`), and a zero-dependency Python 3.11+ client-side `age`-encrypted Git + LFS + multi-harness prose vault (`42/42` unit tests across `Windows`, `Linux`, `macOS`).
- [ai0s-public](https://github.com/ai0S-laboratories/ai0s-public) (`ai0S-public-v2@sha256:409cfd7bfe053a986892b7595f92ad3cc462298b38f3736925cb746aeafcecbe`): Signed Genesis Bootloader v2 archive — `README.md`, `BOOTLOADER-V2-DE.md`, `BOOTLOADER-V2-EN.md`, `AI0S-RUNTIME.0s` plus detached Ed25519 signatures, `VERIFY.md`, and zero-dependency Bitcoin anchor verifier (`verify-anchor.py`).
